SPPU Ledger Copy Information  Definition of a Ledger Copy A Ledger Copy is an official master result sheet issued by Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU). It contains detailed academic information, including: • Course Codes • Subject-wise Marks and Grades • In-Sem Examination (ISE) Marks • End-Sem Examination (ESE) Marks • Term Work (TW) Marks • Practical and Oral Marks (where applicable) • Credit Points • SGPA and CGPA for current 8th-semester students • Overall Academic Performance  Key Details Master Compilation A Ledger Copy contains the complete result data for an entire class, division, or college. It is not limited to a single student's result.  Official Access These ledgers are primarily designated for College Examination Sections and other authorized university officials. The complete ledger is generally restricted and is not issued to individual students.  Purpose Colleges utilize the Ledger Copy for: • Result Analysis • Credit Verification • Pass and Fail Statistics • Academic Record Verification  Can Students View Their Ledger Entry? Yes. A student may request their Examination Coordinator (Exam Section) to view their individual ledger entry. This is generally permitted solely for verification purposes and is subject to the college's discretion.  Students may verify the following details: • In-Sem (ISE) Marks • End-Sem (ESE) Marks • Term Work (TW) Marks • Practical and Oral Marks • Subject Grades • Credit Points • SGPA and other academic details  Important Notice Viewing is typically permitted only in the presence of Exam Section staff. The creation of photographs, videos, or copies of the Ledger is generally prohibited.  Additional Note A Ledger Copy is an institutional document intended for official academic and administrative purposes. Students are generally provided with their own individual result documents rather than the complete class ledger. However, they may request to view their own ledger entry through the college Exam Section for verification, subject to college regulations.
